video_title: Adventure Starts Here: Your New Favorite Tee
video_hook: Bold orange fabric catches sunlight as hands reveal the mountain logo - adventure calling in 3, 2, 1...
target_audience: Outdoor enthusiasts, adventure seekers, and casual wear lovers aged 18-35
video_objective: Showcase the t-shirt's vibrant color, quality fabric, and adventure-ready style to drive purchase intent

scenes.scene_purpose: Create immediate visual impact and introduce the product with dramatic flair
scenes.setting: Minimalist white studio backdrop with dramatic lighting

frames.visual_prompt: Hands dramatically unfold a vibrant orange t-shirt against pure white background, fabric flowing in slow motion with golden hour lighting creating warm shadows and highlights on the orange fabric
frames.lighting: dramatic golden hour backlighting with soft fill
frames.background_details: Clean white seamless backdrop with subtle gradient shadows

frames.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of the circular mountain logo on the left chest, camera slowly zooming in to reveal intricate mountain peak details with orange fabric texture visible around the logo
frames.lighting: soft directional light highlighting logo details
frames.background_details: Blurred orange fabric texture creating depth of field

frames.visual_prompt: Quick dynamic rotation shot of the t-shirt suspended in air, spinning to show front and back views with the orange color popping against the white background, fabric moving naturally
frames.lighting: bright even studio lighting with rim light
frames.background_details: Pure white cyclorama with subtle floor reflection

scenes.scene_purpose: Connect the product with outdoor adventure lifestyle and demonstrate versatility
scenes.setting: Outdoor mountain trail with natural lighting and scenic backdrop

frames.visual_prompt: Attractive young person putting on the orange t-shirt outdoors, mountains visible in background, natural wind catching the fabric as they adjust the fit with confident smile
frames.lighting: natural golden hour sunlight with mountain backdrop
frames.background_details: Scenic mountain range with hiking trail, pine trees, and blue sky

frames.visual_prompt: Low angle hero shot of model wearing the orange t-shirt standing confidently on rocky outcrop, arms crossed, mountain peaks behind them, t-shirt color contrasting beautifully with blue sky
frames.lighting: natural sunlight with dramatic sky contrast
frames.background_details: Majestic mountain peaks, rocky terrain, and expansive blue sky with white clouds

frames.visual_prompt: Close-up of model's torso showing how the t-shirt fits during movement, fabric stretching naturally as they reach for climbing gear, logo clearly visible and fabric quality apparent
frames.lighting: soft natural light with dappled shadows
frames.background_details: Blurred outdoor gear and natural rock formations

scenes.scene_purpose: Highlight fabric quality, fit, and comfort while building desire for purchase
scenes.setting: Modern lifestyle setting with warm, inviting atmosphere

frames.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of hands feeling the soft cotton fabric of the orange t-shirt, fingers running along the material showing texture and quality, warm lighting emphasizing the premium feel
frames.lighting: warm soft lighting with shallow depth of field
frames.background_details: Blurred warm interior setting with natural textures

frames.visual_prompt: Model wearing the t-shirt in casual indoor setting, stretching arms above head to show fit and comfort, natural smile showing satisfaction, orange color vibrant under warm interior lighting
frames.lighting: warm natural window light with cozy ambiance
frames.background_details: Modern minimalist interior with plants and natural elements

frames.visual_prompt: Final product shot of the orange t-shirt laid flat with perfect styling, mountain logo prominently displayed, surrounded by adventure accessories like compass and map, creating desire to purchase
frames.lighting: bright even lighting with slight vignette
frames.background_details: Styled flat lay with wooden surface, outdoor gear props, and natural textures
